The synthetic inventory system still concentrates most peak shortages in December–January. Economics should reflect that current dataset rather than tuning it away.

Step 3C v5 replenishes to a weeks-of-supply target and the plan year ends in late June at the annual inventory low, so little stock survives to 27+ weeks. Liquidation and season-end markdown are therefore present but immaterial; obsolescence and carrying cost dominate over-buy exposure.
